reviewItem.question: For "OperatorHub Packages Discontinued: We no longer publish OperatorHub packages for cert-manager", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether cert-manager in the environment is installed or updated through OperatorHub (OLM subscription) rather than another distribution method

proposed.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages: v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), and the cert-manager-olm repository is archived.
